profile.headline: Results-Driven Software Engineering Leader | Delivering Innovative & Scalable Architectures
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineering Leader with a proven track record of delivering innovative SaaS and SOA solutions. Adept at steering complex projects, enhancing performance, and fostering high-performing teams. Passionate about driving technological innovation and committed to exceeding expectations to fuel business growth.

Key Skills:

* Software Engineering Leadership
* Strategic Product Roadmap Management
* Technical Mentorship and Cross-Functional Coordination
* Agile Methodologies and Continuous Improvement
* SaaS and SOA Solutions
* Database Design and Scalable Architecture
* Full-Stack Development
* Expertise in Java Technologies, RESTful APIs, and Microservices Architecture
* Adherence to Security Best Practices

Driven by results, I excel in creating value through cutting-edge technology and collaborative leadership.

positions.title: Director of Product Engineering
positions.description:
• Oversaw design and implementation of multiple SaaS product architectures and roadmaps using Java, Python, PostgreSQL, and RESTful APIs
• Developed a new testing framework, significantly improving code coverage and reducing production bugs
• Managed multiple engineering teams, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment
• Prototyped and guided teams through high-profile projects, resulting in substantial increases in product availability and revenue
• Cultivated a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning, empowering teams to consistently deliver exceptional software solutions
• Managed product roadmap and budgets, ensuring efficient resource allocation and maximizing return on investment
positions.insights: Strategic Planning, Product Management and +11 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• Led a high-performing team of 10+ engineers, promoting a culture of innovation and continuous improvement
• Directed self-organizing Agile teams, prioritizing customer satisfaction through iterative development and feedback
• Collaborated with stakeholders to define user stories, establish product requirements, and align with business priorities
• Implemented a CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins, significantly reducing time to market and development efficiency
• Developed tailored solutions for clients, enhancing customer satisfaction
• Oversaw product roadmaps and high-priority projects, ensuring timely delivery and meeting key milestones
• Implemented architectural best practices, reducing technical debt and enhancing code quality
positions.insights: Software Management, Project Management and +12 skills

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• Built and led a high-performing team of 5 engineers to deliver a SaaS product using Java EE and Vue.js
• Pioneered DevOps workflows with Ansible for AWS deployment, significantly reducing deployment time
• Initiated and oversaw the transition to microservices architecture, resulting in significant improvements in scalability, resilience, and development efficiency
• Introduced continuous integration, facilitating early testing and faster feedback loops
• Trained and mentored engineers, accelerating their professional growth
• Provided technical expertise to account managers and solutions architects, improving client satisfaction
• Streamlined development processes by implementing Agile methodologies, enhancing team productivity
• Optimized database queries, reducing page load times by 50%
positions.insights: Software Management, Software as a Service (SaaS) and +10 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Designed and developed custom build systems that generated multiple versions and custom Windows installation packages
• Created modules for marketing and accounting departments, integrating MySQL database to generate reports
• Developed modules for a tier 1 and 2 customer account management system
• Upgraded Nyms, a disposable email product, to support newer operating systems
• Contributed to the development of new features and enhancements that improved website functionality and performance
• Provided ongoing maintenance and support for the website's design, ensuring an optimal user experience and addressing technical issues promptly

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Led the development of a custom desktop application using Swing/Eclipse SWT within a client-server architecture, from inception to deployment
• Gathered user requirements, designed a robust server component, and implemented a comprehensive testing strategy to ensure high-quality delivery
• Developed a web-based student information system, improving application processing and payments
• Managed MySQL database administration, ensuring data security and integrity through well-defined policies and procedures
